mathematical_audit.continued_fraction: Continuant reversal gives a/c=[w_m;...;w_1], with every partial quotient at most A. The last convergent has denominator c and is unavailable when B<c.
mathematical_audit.linear_form: For a reduced r/s=-beta/alpha, Legendre's contrapositive handles nonconvergents and the standard next-denominator bound handles proper convergents, yielding |alpha*a+beta*c|>=c/((A+2)B). Restoring the common divisor only strengthens the bound.
mathematical_audit.affine_shift: When 2(A+2)B^2<c, a shift |gamma|<=B removes at most half the linear-form lower bound. Dividing by D<=B gives |H|>=c/(2(A+2)B^2).
mathematical_audit.asymptotic_scale: The recurrence gives a=(A-4)c+q_(n-3) with q_(n-3)<c, hence c<a<(A-3)c and b=Aa+c<A^2c. Therefore log c=log b+O(log n), while log B=o(log b), so every q-dependent branch has log|H|=(1+o(1))log b.
mathematical_audit.residual: If alpha=beta=0, the nonzero integer H=gamma/D has sub-beta height. It would close the branch only after proving the actual divisibility U_11|H; no such residual is constructed.
mathematical_audit.method_scope: Fixed q-windows and affine recurrences are covered only when their unrolled reduced coefficient height is sub-beta. Fixed recurrence order by itself is not closed, as an order-one product accumulator may have beta-scale height.
mathematical_audit.capacity: A one-copy q-dependent carrier cannot prove zero rate or any fixed fractional saving. Since the q-free divisibility implication remains open, booking and capacity reduction are both zero.

PROVED_SCOPED_NO_GO: candidate-independent q-dependent affine-rational carriers with sub-beta reduced coefficient and denominator height
